title: fix(gateway): prevent unusable runtime choices and missing shared drafts
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes unusable model/runtime selections for operators with role restrictions and missing shared-chat draft previews when a connected viewer is absent from the bounded presence cache.

## User Impact

Unsupported runtimes show an availability reason before selection; compatible runtimes remain available. Connected viewers receive shared drafts while authorization, identity deduplication and disconnect checks remain enforced. No configuration migration or protocol-version change is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Runtime selection, creation, catalogs and `/model` now share the execution owner's policy capability check, including account-preserving choices, resets, inherited defaults and commit-time revalidation. Draft delivery reads the live client registry snapshot. Duplicate create validation, obsolete presence mocks and the redundant UI runtime-entry type are removed. The policy leaf consumes only the runtime capability fields, avoiding a type-import cycle.

Release notes: prevent selecting runtimes unable to enforce an operator role; restore shared typing previews for connected viewers evicted from beacon presence.

## Evidence

- Negative controls on the unfixed production modules failed at all three expected assertions: two unsupported-role selections and live-viewer draft delivery. Repaired modules pass those regressions.
- Protocol/native model generation checks passed; nine focused test files passed (149 tests), covering selection, catalogs, directives, execution admission, typing, disconnect and shared visibility. The two files affected by the final test extraction/simplification passed again (71 tests).
- Independent source review resolved the inherited/default selection gap; a fresh review of the final extraction and validation ordering found no actionable issue. Local autoreview of the final committed range `f3739110ca52..037b89bb3174` is scoped-clean at P0-P2 (source-only review; tests executed separately). The complete packaged build passed. Local ClawSweeper was unavailable. Hosted review of the preceding head found no code defect and requested real final-delivery proof; the new WebSocket regression supplies it.
- CI on the initial head identified an unsafe tuple assertion in the new fixture and two stale mock-baseline entries. The test-only correction preserves every assertion; the affected gateway-server type graph, eight presence tests and exact mock-export ratchet now pass locally. Independent review of that correction is clean.
- Later CI exposed a type-import cycle and two lint errors. The cycle check now reports zero cycles; targeted lint, UI typechecking and the affected gateway-methods type graph pass. UI model/runtime tests pass (61 tests), and native selection tests pass (26 tests). No failed CI run is represented as green.
- Real final-delivery proof: `src/gateway/server-methods/sessions-typing.delivery.test.ts` passes through production connection state, broadcaster, session subscriptions, resident sharing policy and WebSocket transport. Four real loopback WebSocket peers use stored role assignments. After actual beacon TTL eviction, allowed readers receive the first draft; a second draft is throttled, a reader is revoked while it waits, and the allowed control receives the pending draft. The denied transport receives zero sends; the revoked transport receives only its earlier authorized draft. Identity/handshake admission is fixture-seeded; socket delivery and authorization are real. This directly addresses the hosted review's final-effect proof and rank-up move. The [fresh hosted review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/193532#issuecomment-6661284355) on `132cbd9bdf258ea92efd4e3eb426ff32c03e6944` confirms the authority-chain gap is resolved, with no actionable findings or before-merge requests.

```json
{"surface":"session.typing","transport":"real-loopback-websocket","broadcaster":"production","authorization":"stored-role-and-session-projection","beacons":"expired","allowedReader":{"received":["first draft","pending draft"]},"deniedReader":{"transportSends":0},"revokedReader":{"transportSends":1,"pendingDraftSent":false},"verdict":"pass"}
```

- Testbox queued without executing the payload and was stopped; proof uses a qualified full local checkout with the exact source patch. Gateway validator freshness passed with no generated changes.
- Production delta: +73 lines for the shared runtime-policy owner boundary and canonical live-presence input; test/support delta: +538 lines, with 541 ratcheted regression lines allocated separately. Compatible native runtimes and built-in enforcement remain covered.
- Live rollout and a two-browser human typing replay remain outside this source PR; no deployment is claimed.
